locations.name: Origin Space
locations.description: A twenty-metre island beneath an unfamiliar sky. Your Core and everything actually inside remain protected. Decide what kind of home this becomes.

locations.name: Stonebrook
locations.description: A repaired bell hangs above an unrepaired pump. The Council wants supplies; its neighbours want to know who will be left outside when the rains come.

locations.name: River-Reed Camp
locations.description: Seasonal river stewards maintain floating gardens and flood markers. Their ordinary specialists know water better than the city's prestigious officers.

locations.name: Greyford
locations.description: The toll gates still carry scars from the Three Banners War. A lost convoy's names appear in two ledgers, with two different explanations.

locations.name: Dawn Archive
locations.description: The Academy has sealed the lower stacks. Preserved testimony can reveal people and opportunities that force alone cannot unlock.

locations.name: Thornwater
locations.description: Old evacuation markers disappear into wet woodland. The beasts moving through it are fleeing a disturbance deeper in the hills.

locations.name: Meridian Gate
locations.description: Permits decide who may enter the old capital. Its guardians are exceptionally trained; they are also bound by a history they did not choose.

buildings.name: Shelter
buildings.description: Unlock free storm sheltering; +4 regional preparation.

buildings.name: Seed garden
buildings.description: Produce 4 food after each resolved action. Prototype abstracts staffing.

buildings.name: Workshop
buildings.description: Gather +4 wood and +2 stone per cache; +4 preparation.

buildings.name: Warning post
buildings.description: A protected planning post supports exterior scouts; +12 regional preparation.

factions.name: Stonebrook Council
factions.goal: Feed the village and preserve local consent.
factions.benefit: +8 preparation and a peaceful tide diversion route.

factions.name: Dawn Academy
factions.goal: Recover knowledge without losing public trust.
factions.benefit: Recover archive evidence and reveal Mira.

factions.name: Greyford Compact
factions.goal: Keep traffic moving and its authority intact.
factions.benefit: +8 preparation and a peaceful tide diversion route.

heroes.name: Elias Reed
heroes.requirementText: Repair the pump, then invite him.
heroes.summary: He sabotaged a toll cart to let refugees escape. A second convoy was stranded by the delay. He now supplies survivors and the dead driver's family without telling them why.

choices.label: Help repair the pump
choices.text: Spend 6 wood; earn trust and a repair promise.
choices.memory: You repaired something before asking me to fight.

choices.label: Ask him to name the lost drivers
choices.text: Record his eyewitness account: civilian wagons remained on the road during the disputed closure. He cannot establish who ordered the delay.
choices.memory: You asked for their names, not for a confession.

recovery.label: Return to repair the pump
recovery.memory: You returned to do the work after hearing my account.
recovery.detail: Make amends without erasing your earlier choice. Gain 10 trust and 5 loyalty; complete the missing recruitment requirement.

heroes.specialty: Active: construction uses 20% less wood (rounded up).

heroes.name: Mara Finch
heroes.summary: A notice she carried diverted medicine to a private warehouse. Her brother still works for the official who signed it. She wants proof before a crowd chooses its villain.

choices.label: Protect the ledger and couriers
choices.text: Spend 4 food; preserve the medicine ledger and its attached 973 dispatch copy, which lists civilian wagons during the closure. Its timetable may be inaccurate.
choices.memory: You protected the people who could contradict you.

choices.label: Accept a quiet alternate trail
choices.text: Gain 8 food and trust; the ledger remains unresolved.
choices.memory: You took the long road instead of risking my brother.

recovery.label: Protect the couriers and recover the records
recovery.memory: You returned for the evidence without making my brother the price.
recovery.detail: Make amends without erasing your earlier choice. Gain 10 trust and 5 loyalty; complete the missing recruitment requirement. Recover the medicine ledger with its attached 973 dispatch copy listing civilian wagons during the closure.

heroes.specialty: Active: each finite supply cache gives 2 extra food.

heroes.name: Owen Ash
heroes.requirementText: Fund a fair restitution hearing for his comrade.
heroes.boundary: Will refuse an order to abandon trapped civilians.
heroes.summary: He stole military equipment to rescue children. His former comrade was sentenced for the missing stock. A brave act left a debt he has avoided facing.

choices.label: Pay for a restitution hearing
choices.text: Spend 8 silver; reopen the case fairly.
choices.memory: You helped me face the cost of being called brave.

choices.label: Celebrate the rescue publicly
choices.text: Gain Council favor, but he distrusts an easy absolution.
choices.memory: You told the part of the story I find easiest to hear.

recovery.label: Replace public praise with a restitution hearing
recovery.memory: You let the celebration end and helped settle what I owed.
recovery.detail: Make amends without erasing your earlier choice. Gain 10 trust and 5 loyalty; complete the missing recruitment requirement.

heroes.specialty: Active: evacuating the tide costs 4 food instead of 8.

heroes.name: Tessa Brook
heroes.requirementText: Preserve samples under a consent charter.
heroes.summary: Her grandmother's seeds feed the village, and her notes conceal failed treatments. Tessa fears that exposing the failures could close the only clinic.

choices.label: Preserve samples with informed consent
choices.text: Spend 4 food; preserve dated preparation notes and samples under a consent charter. Several treatment entries lack patient follow-up.
choices.memory: You allowed uncertainty into the public record.

choices.label: Publish the failures immediately
choices.text: Gain evidence and favor; patients hear before Tessa can explain.
choices.memory: Truth arrived faster than we could help people understand it.

recovery.label: Repair trust through consent and preserved samples
recovery.memory: You returned to preserve our notes, missing follow-ups and all, with consent.
recovery.detail: Make amends without erasing your earlier choice. Gain 10 trust and 5 loyalty; complete the missing recruitment requirement.

heroes.specialty: Active: the seed garden produces 2 extra food per watch.

heroes.name: Arin Vale
heroes.requirementText: Preserve the last convoy testimony. Condensed prototype threshold: trust 5.
heroes.boundary: Challenges orders that glorify avoidable casualties.
heroes.summary: He blames a captain for his brother's loss. The retreat also saved his own family. His brother may have volunteered to hold the road, leaving him without the simple enemy he wanted.

choices.label: Listen to both convoy accounts
choices.text: Spend 3 food; a surviving witness describes civilian wagons still on the road during the disputed closure. The account cannot establish Arin's brother's fate.
choices.memory: You did not take my anger for evidence.

choices.label: Promise him a glorious reckoning
choices.text: Gain trust quickly, but establish a dangerous promise.
choices.memory: You promised me someone to blame.

recovery.label: Replace the promise of vengeance with witness testimony
recovery.memory: You corrected your promise and listened to the surviving witness.
recovery.detail: Make amends without erasing your earlier choice. Gain 10 trust and 5 loyalty; complete the missing recruitment requirement. A witness places civilian wagons on the road; Arin's brother's fate remains unknown.

heroes.specialty: Active: strongest recruitable frontline contribution in this small chapter.

heroes.name: Mira Ellery
heroes.boundary: Will not open unsafe spatial routes.
heroes.summary: Her family's formula rescued refugees and enabled research linked to destabilizing those routes. The Academy teaches only half of that history.

choices.label: Publish a limited, safe research charter
choices.text: Gain Academy favor and a new research charter. Mira also supplies a witnessed historic copy governing duties at public passage anchors. She includes a limited technical passage-duty extract for comparison.
choices.memory: You separated the right to know from the means to repeat a disaster.

choices.label: Keep the technical record restricted
choices.text: Gain trust through restricted technical custody. Mira supplies the same witnessed historic copy, without permission to publish unsafe procedures. She includes a limited technical passage-duty extract for comparison.
choices.memory: You accepted a duty that could not be made heroic.

heroes.name: Kael Mercer
heroes.summary: His retreat saved the main convoy. His false report protected a patron and denied abandoned families compensation. Institutional peace and personal cowardice both shaped his decision.

choices.label: Hold a fair inquiry
choices.text: Spend 5 silver; record his deposition that civilian wagons remained during the disputed 973 closure. His report does not settle who ordered each delay.
choices.memory: You let me answer without letting me erase what I did.

choices.label: Trade silence for emergency supplies
choices.text: Gain 10 wood and 8 food; sacrifice his trust.
choices.memory: You made my old excuse profitable again.

heroes.name: Seren Hart
heroes.requirementText: Offer survivors refuge without claiming ownership.
heroes.boundary: Refuses to surrender survivors as property.
heroes.summary: A restoration order recruited her to heal displaced families, then selected patients for experiments. She helped people escape but still hopes one surviving technique could treat a wasting illness.

choices.label: Offer unconditional refuge
choices.text: Spend 5 food; survivors may leave freely. Volunteers describe preparation methods matching clinic notes; nobody agrees to an experiment.
choices.memory: Your sanctuary had an exit as well as a door.

choices.label: Recover only the treatment records
choices.text: Gain evidence, but leave the survivors' immediate need unmet.
choices.memory: You saved what we knew before asking whether we were safe.

recovery.label: Return for the people behind the records
recovery.memory: You came back to offer refuge. Those who wished to speak could do so freely.
recovery.detail: Make amends without erasing your earlier choice. Gain 10 trust and 5 loyalty; complete the missing recruitment requirement. Volunteers describe preparation methods matching the clinic notes; participation remains optional.

heroes.specialty: Active: sheltering storm survivors gives each deployed companion 2 additional trust.

heroes.name: Rowan Grey
heroes.boundary: Rejects reforms that erase a supply route without replacing it.
heroes.summary: His monopoly fed Stonebrook through famine and trapped its farmers in debt. His family grew rich while he spent profits keeping the village alive. Both accounts are true.

choices.label: Fund a second supply route
choices.text: Spend 10 silver; gain 12 food and Council favor.
choices.memory: You brought an alternative, not only an accusation.

choices.label: Renew the emergency monopoly
choices.text: Gain 15 silver; farmers lose bargaining power.
choices.memory: You made survival easier today and argument harder tomorrow.

heroes.name: Evelyn Crowe
heroes.boundary: Cannot invalidate a protected Origin Core.
heroes.summary: Her tutors raised her to guard sanctuary law using an edited charter. Exposing the edited record might free her, or strengthen rivals demanding control over public routes. They cannot override a protected Core.

choices.label: Propose voluntary guardianship
choices.text: Gain a civic charter and trust; no hereditary claim over your Core.
choices.memory: You asked what I would choose if inheritance could not answer.

choices.label: Recognize her inherited authority
choices.text: Gain 10 silver in support; leave the edited charter unresolved.
choices.memory: You trusted my title before I could decide whether I trusted it.
